name: aria_automation_status
description: Read host scheduler heartbeat, last bridge update check and schedule runtime.

name: aria_automation_schedules
description: List durable schedules with compare-and-swap hashes. Action arguments are redacted.

name: aria_automation_dashboard
description: Create and return a private static HTML status snapshot, available on the host without ChatGPT. No HTTP listener.

name: aria_automation_jobs
description: List recent jobs and queued/running states. Read individual job status for full output.

name: aria_automation_inbox
description: Read locally stored job failure and automation notifications; no external messages.

name: aria_automation_schedule_save
description: Create/update an interval, daily or job-success workflow. Edits require the current schedule hash. Automation runs only when management is idle; changed scripts fail their pinned hash. No container schedules are installed by default.

event_action.description: Successful source action for an event rule.

arguments.description: Arguments for the selected action without request_id; target action schema is validated. Pin script/profile/template hashes.

window_end.description: Optional exclusive HH:MM end; supports windows spanning midnight.

window_timezone.description: IANA timezone of the maintenance window.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 from schedule list; empty string only for creation.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier; repeat only to recover the same operation.

use_event_archive.description: For an archive-create success event leading to archive verification, bind archive_id and expected_sha256 from that exact job result; omit those two fields from arguments.

name: aria_automation_schedule_delete
description: Delete a schedule using its current hash.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 from schedule list; empty string only for creation.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier; repeat only to recover the same operation.

name: aria_automation_job_cancel
description: Immediately cancel a queued job atomically. Running or ambiguous jobs cannot be cancelled through this action.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier; repeat only to recover the same operation.
Unique request identifier; repeat only to recover the same operation.

name: aria_automation_bridge_check
description: Check fixed repository main for bridge changes and verify GitHub CI without installing. The separate default daily host schedule can install CI-verified revisions during its maintenance window.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier; repeat only to recover the same operation.
